title: Fennel Correspondence
description: The opening three-bar song is answered an octave lower, while the upper hand becomes a quiet harmonic frame. Later exchanges change the melody and its surroundings. The D–F–E–A thought comes from Fennel Daybreak; its final lower return ends alone on F.
difficulty: Intermediate to advanced melody exchange and changing LH clefs
technical_note: Bring forward the hand carrying the moving phrase and keep the held chords softer. The first answer in bars 4–6 is exactly one octave below bars 1–3. Follow the written LH clef changes; the last bar belongs to the LH alone.

performance.note: Hear each lower phrase as a reply, with a different harmonic background. Keep the chordal hand quiet and allow the final lower F to be heard by itself.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
